title: Kloofendal 48d Partly Cloudy (Pure Sky)
processing: Unmodified official 1K Radiance HDR. No generated pixels, resampling, baked exposure or texture edits.

orientation.method: Brightest linear-luminance RGBE pixel centre. Preserve prior key azimuth and use the photograph's actual elevation. Visible dome uses inverse environment rotation and the same equirectangular convention as GLPMREM.

usage: Optional Safari environment study only. Replaces the existing 1K forest input for both visible sky and existing PMREM lighting; same sky-cube draw, same 512-pixel shadow, no added framebuffer or per-frame pass. Panorama is linear and goes through the existing ACES/output encoding once. Legacy buggy and portrait profiles stay unchanged.
limitations: One static distant sky photograph, not volumetric clouds or local weather. PureSky lower hemisphere is an artist-supplied sky extension, not measured local terrain irradiance. Environment intensity and weak warm hemisphere fill are art direction for the fictional stage. Native visual/performance review remains required.
